evaluations.rationale: Selected. It is the smallest causal repair for the directly observed mismatch and includes both an unsafe case and benign controls.
Superseded by r2-v1 for implementation. The incumbent's main discriminator is complete and keeping it adds no new executable step.
Deferred. Plain equality on a token containing an assignment would not equal the bare option name and could allow the unsafe form, so the proposal is less precise than normalized prefix checking.
Deferred to a later iteration because it depends on the repair existing first; it is the strongest residual-bypass hypothesis.
Deferred. The smaller repair can avoid re-joining entirely, so the double-normalization failure mode may not exist.
Deferred in favor of the smaller r2-v1 patch, which implements the same final-token invariant. The invariant should still appear in regression evidence.
